excavation_context.character_description: Adult female grad student museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a white lab coat, white skirt, and light blue pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 is seated at a clean laboratory desk, carefully applying liquid chemical stabilizer with a precise glass dropper onto a thin, flat slab of slate grey shale. The split shale sheet reveals a pristine, carbonized silhouette of an Anchiornis skeleton complete with delicate wing feather imprints. Soft, shadowless laboratory ambient lighting. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
